property.name: BoundField
property.description-key: Host text field used to place and bind the PCF control on the form.

property.name: inputValue
property.description-key: Optional direct prompt sent to the AI endpoint. When populated, it takes priority over the generated CRM-field prompt.

property.name: caseDetails
property.description-key: Case details text used to build the generated AI prompt when Prompt Override is empty.

property.name: providerName
property.description-key: Service provider option set used in the generated AI prompt. The option label is sent instead of the numeric value.

property.name: providerResponse
property.description-key: Service provider response text used to build the generated AI prompt when Prompt Override is empty.

property.name: apiEndpoint
property.description-key: URL of the Dataverse custom API or external endpoint called to generate the AI recommendation. Required unless Testing Response JSON is populated.

property.name: isBaseUrlDynamicallyHandled
property.description-key: When Yes, the PCF uses the current Dataverse client URL as the endpoint base URL and keeps only the configured /api/data/... path.

value.name: No
value.description-key: Use the configured API Endpoint exactly as entered.

value.name: Yes
value.description-key: Replace the configured endpoint base URL with the current user.s Dataverse client URL.

property.name: testingResponseJson
property.description-key: Optional raw JSON response used for testing the PCF parser and UI without calling the API endpoint. When populated, Generate uses this value as the returned response.

property.name: requestMethod
property.description-key: HTTP method used for the AI endpoint call. Supported values are GET, POST, PUT, and PATCH. Defaults to POST.

property.name: requestTemplate
property.description-key: Optional JSON body template for the AI endpoint. Template tokens such as CaseId and inputText are replaced before sending.

property.name: headersJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON object containing additional HTTP headers to send with the AI request.

property.name: apiVersion
property.description-key: Version value sent in the x-api-version header. Defaults to 1.0 when empty.

property.name: includeLegalNoteText
property.description-key: Controls whether legal note text is requested from the AI endpoint when the request template uses this flag.

property.name: isDisabled
property.description-key: Disables review actions in the AI Advisor while keeping the Generate button available.

value.name: No
value.description-key: Keep AI Advisor review actions enabled.

value.name: Yes
value.description-key: Disable review actions but allow Generate.

property.name: isdevleopment
property.description-key: Controls whether development-only UI sections and console logs are shown.

value.name: Production
value.description-key: Hides raw returned JSON, option-set numeric values, and debug console logs.

value.name: Development
value.description-key: Shows raw returned JSON, option-set numeric values, and debug console logs.

property.name: includeLegalNotes
property.description-key: Controls whether returned legal notes are created and associated to the Case when the AI decision is Assess Dispute.

value.name: DoNotInclude
value.description-key: Do not create or associate returned legal notes.

value.name: Include
value.description-key: Create and associate returned legal notes when the AI decision is Assess Dispute.

property.name: isBpfHandled
property.description-key: Controls whether the PCF checks the current Business Process Flow stage before allowing actions.

value.name: No
value.description-key: Do not check the Business Process Flow stage.

value.name: Yes
value.description-key: Check the Business Process Flow stage before enabling PCF actions.

property.name: allowUnsupportedFormRefresh
property.description-key: Allows the PCF to refresh the CRM form through unsupported Xrm.Page APIs after Accept, Modify, or Reject. Set to Yes only when needed.

value.name: No
value.description-key: Do not use unsupported form refresh

value.name: Yes
value.description-key: Use unsupported Xrm.Page form refresh after user actions

property.name: applyInvalidReasonRequirement
property.description-key: Controls whether Accept is blocked when Validation by AI is Invalid and Invalid Reason by AI is empty or invalid.

value.name: No
value.description-key: Do not block Accept when Invalid Reason by AI is missing.

value.name: Yes
value.description-key: Block Accept when Validation by AI is Invalid and Invalid Reason by AI is missing or invalid.

property.name: bpfEntityName
property.description-key: Logical name of the Business Process Flow table used to check the active stage. Accepts a single input.

property.name: bpfCaseLookupFieldName
property.description-key: Logical name of the BPF lookup field that links the BPF instance to the Case. Accepts a single input.

property.name: allowedBpfStageNames
property.description-key: Business Process Flow stage names where the PCF is allowed to run. Accepts comma-separated inputs or a single input.

property.name: serviceStatus
property.description-key: Current Case service status lookup. Bind this to ldv_servicestatus so the PCF can detect when Service Provider feedback has moved to Customer Care.

property.name: serviceStatusFieldName
property.description-key: Optional Case service status lookup logical name used for live Web API reads. Defaults to ldv_servicestatus.

property.name: routeToServiceProviderCount
property.description-key: Current route-to-service-provider counter. Bind this to the Case count field so each route-back can trigger one new auto generation.

property.name: routeToServiceProviderCountFieldName
property.display-name-key: Route to Service Provider Count Logical Name
property.description-key: Optional Case route-to-service-provider count logical name used for live Web API reads. Defaults to ldv_routetoserviceprovidercount.

property.name: autoGenerateServiceStatusNames
property.description-key: Service status names that allow auto generation after Service Provider feedback. Accepts comma-separated inputs or a single input. Defaults to Pending on Customer Care.

property.name: routeToSPReasonLookupLogicalName
property.display-name-key: Route to Service Provider Reason Lookup Logical Name
property.description-key: Optional target table logical name used when emitting the Route to Service Provider Reason lookup output on Modify.

property.name: department1LookupLogicalName
property.description-key: Optional target table logical name used when emitting the Department 1 lookup output on Modify.

property.name: resultPath
property.description-key: Optional JSON path used to read a specific value from the AI response when no standard feedback field is returned.

property.name: decisionByAI
property.description-key: Bound option set field populated with the AI decision value after Accept or Modify.

property.name: customerCallSuggestionInstructionsByAI
property.display-name-key: Customer Call Suggestion Instructions by AI
property.description-key: Bound multiline field populated with AI customer call instructions when returned by the endpoint.

property.name: validationByAI
property.description-key: Bound option set field populated with the AI validation value only when the AI decision is Assess Dispute.

property.name: invalidReason
property.description-key: Bound option set field populated with the AI invalid reason only when validation is Invalid.

property.name: closedInFavorOf
property.display-name-key: Closed in Favor of by AI
property.description-key: Bound option set field populated with who the case should close in favor of when the AI decision is Assess Dispute.

property.name: routeToSPReasons
property.description-key: Bound lookup field populated with the AI route-to-service-provider reason returned in RouteToSPReasonsJson.

property.name: department1
property.description-key: Bound lookup field populated with the AI Department 1 value returned in Department1Json.

property.name: assessDisputeComment
property.description-key: Bound comment field populated only when the AI decision is Assess Dispute.

property.name: routeToServiceProviderComment
property.description-key: Bound comment field populated only when the AI decision is Route to Service Provider.

property.name: routeToDepartmentComment
property.description-key: Bound comment field populated only when the AI decision is Route to Department.

property.name: escalateToLeadComment
property.description-key: Bound comment field populated only when the AI decision is Escalate to Lead.

property.name: suggestedComment
property.description-key: Bound multiline field populated with the AI feedback text for compatibility with older mappings.

property.name: suggestedDecision
property.description-key: Bound text field populated with the AI decision label for compatibility with older mappings.

property.name: legalNotesJson
property.description-key: Bound multiline field populated with the legal notes JSON returned by the AI endpoint.

property.name: correlationId
property.description-key: Bound text field populated with the request correlation ID used for tracing the AI call.

property.name: resultText
property.description-key: Bound text field populated with the main AI response text for compatibility with older mappings.

property.name: resultJson
property.description-key: Bound multiline field populated with the full formatted AI response JSON.

property.name: statusText
property.description-key: Bound text field populated with the latest PCF status message.

property.name: lastRunOn
property.description-key: Bound date and time field populated with when the AI recommendation was generated.

property.name: feedbackByAI
property.description-key: Bound multiline field populated with the AI feedback that should be reflected on the Case.

property.name: reservedDecisionByAI
property.description-key: Bound option set field that stores the last AI decision for persistent PCF display.

property.name: reservedFeedbackByAI
property.description-key: Bound multiline field that stores the last AI feedback for persistent PCF display.

property.name: reservedValidationByAI
property.description-key: Bound option set field that stores the last AI validation for persistent PCF display.

property.name: reservedInvalidReasonByAI
property.description-key: Bound option set field that stores the last AI invalid reason for persistent PCF display.

property.name: reservedCustomerCallSuggestionInstructionsByAI
property.display-name-key: Reserved Customer Call Suggestion Instructions by AI
property.description-key: Bound multiline field that stores the last AI customer call instructions for persistent PCF display.

property.name: reservedClosedInFavorOfByAI
property.display-name-key: Reserved Closed in Favor of by AI
property.description-key: Bound option set field that stores the last AI closed-in-favor-of value for persistent PCF display.

property.name: aiReviewStatusLabel
property.description-key: Bound text field that stores the last user action taken on the AI recommendation: Accepted, Modified, or Rejected.

property.name: lastAutoGeneratedServiceStatus
property.description-key: Reserved text field used by the PCF to store the service status GUID already processed by automatic generation.

property.name: lastAutoGeneratedRouteToServiceProviderCount
property.display-name-key: Last Auto Generated Route to Service Provider Count
property.description-key: Reserved whole number field used by the PCF to remember the route-to-service-provider count already processed by automatic generation.
